findings.current: Вставить расшифровку / Вставить расшифровку для проверки (Enter)
findings.problem: ru style guide pins transcript → «транскрипт» (used for the chat transcript, e.g. Вид транскрипта). Here 'transcript' means the dictated words, a different sense; the translators chose «расшифровка» (and «Расшифровать» in send_recording_hint) while dictation_failed_* says «служба транскрипции». Defensible and consistent across the three new keys, and it avoids colliding with the chat transcript, but it is an unrecorded deviation from the guide.
findings.suggested: Keep the current wording. Record the call in the ru style guide (dictated text → «расшифровка»; chat log → «транскрипт») so a later pass does not 'fix' it. Do not switch to «транскрипт»: it would read as the chat log.

findings.current: Направить агента сейчас (Enter) · Esc остановит ход
findings.problem: «Направить агента» alone can read as 'send the agent somewhere'. Same verb root is already the settled rendering of steer in placeholder.waiting («Направляйте агента») and mesh_approvals («направлять текущий ход»), so consistency outweighs the ambiguity; the Esc clause makes the meaning clear.
findings.suggested: No change required. If a later pass wants it unambiguous: «Дать агенту указание сейчас (Enter) · Esc остановит ход» (55 chars, within 64).

limits: Source/bytes reading only: no rendered frame, no width measurement, no runtime. ru is LTR: no RTL assessment applies. Not a second independent pass (not requested for this delta).
